relationships.subject: MgH2
relationships.evidence_quote: Histological analysis showed that MgH2 reduced microglia activation and Nlrp3 inflammasome formation in the hippocampus.

relationships.subject: TRPM2
relationships.evidence_quote: MgH2 inhibited TRPM2 channel activation, which is implicated in calcium influx, mitochondrial ROS (mtROS) production, and subsequent NLRP3 inflammasome activation.

relationships.subject: bone cancer pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis confirmed a time-dependent escalation in TRPM2, NLRP3, CASP1, ASC (Pycard), and IBA1 protein levels within the hippocampus of BCP rats

key_findings: MgH2 reduces hippocampal TRPM2/NLRP3 inflammasome activation, pain and depressive behavior in BCP rats and lowers fentanyl tolerance.
